# Phase 3 · Wave 1 gate report (P3-2 / P3-3 / P3-4)

2026-10-01 · branch `design/three-films` · W1 integrated in `4f4f7ef`, measured in `42c17f9`, fixed in
`ab48b31` → `83bd74e` → `7fe2f12` → `4e0eb74` → this commit. Headless Chromium 141, 4 CPUs, SwiftShader
(software raster): read absolute frame numbers as relative. Base = the pre-Phase-3 build `5aa4587` on :3162.

**Verdict.** P3-4 passes its W1 gate. P3-2 passes everything but #7 (two raster targets and CLS still above
target headless) and #11 (inherited from before Phase 3, deferred to W2-CARDS). P3-3 passes everything but
#1 (the hand-off script and the intro run's fps are still above target headless). Only P3-4 is ticked.

---

## 1. What shipped

**Wave 1 (`4f4f7ef`):**
- Lenis + ScrollTrigger as ladder step 1, after the quiet window.
- The persistent stage: backdrops plus three split windows.
- Beats in the manifest, the validator checks, the beats probe and the spotlight.
- The raster diet.
- The intro hand-off (warm → hold → reveal) and the opening titles.
- Per-world type, with the Pirata name.
- 19 living loops plus SEQ-HALL registered.

**The fix stage**

*Bundle (P3-2 #10).* First-load JS went from **+27.4 KB gz to +1.5 KB gz** against base.
- A browser-only Turbopack loader (`scripts/build/browser-data-loader.cjs`, wired in `next.config.ts`) removes fields only the server reads from the client copies of four modules:
  - `lib/media.ts`: provenance becomes `{source}`;
  - `lib/variants.ts`: note, plan and files;
  - `lib/page.ts` and `lib/film.ts`: beats, tempo and estVh.
- Server renders, Node, tsc and the validator still read the full source.
- The loader fails the build if a module stops matching.
- Static facades now lazy-load their implementation on DESKTOP_FINE (DESKTOP_WIDE for fonts): `SmoothScroll`, `WorldFonts`, `StageGate`, `LetterboxBars` (and `useLetterboxScene`), and the cut overlay.
- `use-scroll-scene` imports the ladder lazily, so `lib/ladder` and `lib/idle` left first load.
- The ladder reads the quiet window from `window.__introQuiet`, so a late-loading ladder chunk never misses it.

*Root cause of most of the jank: any restyle of `<html>` itself restyled the whole document (70–100 ms headless).*
- `[class*="world-face-"]` is now four named classes. A class change on `<html>` went from 77–105 ms to 0 ms.
- No CSS rule keys on Lenis's own `html.lenis*` classes any more. Lenis rewrites them at every glide start and stop.
  - The page is Lenis-ready from first paint under the boot gate (`app/p3/foundation.css`).
  - A view that booted paused and then resumed gets `html[data-smooth]` once.
- Pause reads its own state before `matchMedia()` (`lib/flags.ts`, the spotlight), and the spotlight's debug log no longer reads `window.scrollY`. Both used to force the restyle that a Pause queues.
- World fonts:
  - family names are read before the token changes `<html>`;
  - **the token is added after the faces load**, so the swap happens once, on loaded faces;
  - the fast lane warms the idiots faces on hover or focus.

*The principles stall (MEASURE §5 #2).* Idle fps went from 0.2–0.6 to **60**, both after a scroll-through and after a jump.
- The parchment sheet and the wear are static promoted layers again.
- The two outer panels are promoted only while they unfold.
- The wear's ten full-sheet gradients are now positioned bands: the same pixels, a fraction of the raster.

*Stage.*
- The loop plays only while its own layer is fully in and no other layer is mid-fade (the 1024 decoder sample).
- The rack-focus soft copy is the 640 rung at q75 (it was 384 at q55).

*Layout.*
- Beyond notes stack below 52rem of the split column.
- The satchel kit wraps (auto-fit).
- Paired facts go to one column below 40rem.

*Research font.*
- `data-research` moved from the gauntlet root to the gates column and the board's data.
- `data-board` marks the board's data, not the scene figure.
- So the lettered Q-3I-2 header and the scene caption (head role, spec §5.1) sit outside every research island.

*Intro.*
- Opening titles show on DESKTOP_FINE only.
- The fast lane before hydration jumps instantly.
- The ALT roll ends on its last line.
- The hold still is a crop-only `createImageBitmap`.

*Cut.* The fade-in wait is capped by a wall-clock timer, so the fast lane lands in 170–300 ms.

*Sound.* Pause and OS reduced motion suspend the context in the same task: 2 ms and 37 ms.

*Header.* The act label re-probes after a late observer change.

*Credits.* The Libraries row is the copy key `credits.libraries` (proposed, unsigned).

*Probes.* The measurer's aa-scrim, layout-gates and lenis fixes are applied. The research-font and scenes selectors follow `data-board`. `static.ric` exempts the vanilla intro controller, with a documented reason.

## 4. Code-review findings (W1 assembly review)

| # | finding | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Long jump through the cut lands off target (y measured before fonts) | **Fixed** (81f7935): measured inside `jump()`. |
| 2 | Hero loop can freeze when the hand-off blob arrives late | **Fixed** (81f7935): VideoLayer keeps its first source; keyed by pick. |
| 3 | `systems.pencil.body` contradicts the Meta line | **Fixed** (81f7935): `boot:hidden` until W2 renders `.p3`. |
| 4 | Tablets get the opening titles | **Fixed** (ab48b31): controller slot and CSS on DESKTOP_FINE. |
| 5 | A newer jump doesn't stop an older cut | **Fixed** (81f7935): `seq`/`gen` guards. |
| 6 | Focus moves even when the glide was interrupted | **Fixed** (81f7935): glides resolve "arrived". |
| 7 | Cut overlay on touch tablets | **Fixed** (81f7935): DESKTOP_FINE only (the overlay now also loads only there). |
| 8 | Fast lane glides before the controller is ready | **Fixed** (ab48b31): `scroll-behavior:auto` for that jump. |
| 9 | StageVideo unloads on AbortError | **Fixed** (ab48b31). |
| 10 | Libraries row skips the sign-off check | **Fixed** (ab48b31): copy key `credits.libraries` (p3, unsigned). |

None was rejected.

**B1-TYPE follow-up (W2):**
- World-font swap CLS: 0.003–0.005 remains on lettered captions and rdr2 h3s. Consider metric overrides (`size-adjust` / `ascent-override`) for the world faces, or a wider approach margin.
- Glue or balance the separators.

**Every builder, a new rule** (`app/p3/foundation.css`, `app/globals.css`):
- Never add a CSS rule that can match `<html>` itself for a class or attribute toggled at runtime.
- Never use `[class*=…]` or similar substring selectors.
- Each such toggle restyles the whole document, 70–100 ms headless.
- `html[data-letterbox]` (stage.css, its scroll-padding) is one such toggle. W3-CINEMA should keep it to once per scene.

**Budget headroom:** first-load JS has ≈ 4.6 KB gz left for W2 (the hunt chip and its store).
